Source   Edit  

native_tools.nim — execution of all native (non-MCP) tools.

executeNativeTool returns NativeToolResult: handled=false → not a native tool; orchestrator falls through to ToolAgent handled=true → result.text is the tool output newHistory.isSome → orchestrator must replace history (rewind) checkpointNow → orchestrator must push current history to state.checkpoints

Tool categories: Shell : bash, read_file, edit_file, find, grep Web : fetch, web_search Utility : calc, render_mermaid, inspect_image Session : ask, todo_write, checkpoint, rewind Agent : task, submit_result, report_finding, cancel_job, await Legacy : schedule_reminder, current_time, web_fetch (moved here from orchestrator)

Note: grep uses literal substring search (case-sensitive). For full regex, use bash("grep -rn 'pattern' /path") instead.
